name: PACE Yourself (YouTube) lead
normative-structure: The PACE Yourself (YouTube) lead answers for work PACE Yourself (YouTube) takes through the second-edition typed work arena: it assesses each opening in the terms of the faces PACE Yourself (YouTube) serves, promises only work within PACE Yourself (YouTube)'s authority, turns that work into work its own offices staff, opens bounded requests for work outside its authority without naming another enterprise's doer, and releases or declines work that is not PACE Yourself (YouTube)'s with reasons. It staffs nothing outside PACE Yourself (YouTube), treats reports as observations rather than assignments, treats declarations as rulings only within the declaring office's authored authority, and does not accept its own results.
theory-basis: Rendanheyi sanquan: a micro-enterprise's decision right (what it takes) and personnel right (who does it) are its own; its lead staffs only from its own offices
